key_insight: The study builds a spin-polarized electronic-structure database for more than 2,500 stable halide double perovskites, revealing a large design space with visible-band-gap and half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: This dataset can accelerate materials screening for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by linking composition to band structure, magnetic behavior, and bonding descriptors.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT for Cs2BB'X6 compounds with X = I, Br, Cl, F
Density of states computed for >2,500 stable candidates predicted by the τ tolerance factor
LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP visualizations and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 719 compounds with visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic materials, alongside DOS and bonding data for the full database.
watch_item: Stability is based on τ-predicted candidates and the results are computational, so experimental validation is still needed before device use.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
